premises: Every prime number greater than 2 is odd.
3 is a prime number greater than 2.
label: True
proof_trace: Rule 1: ∀x (Prime(x) ∧ x > 2 → Odd(x)). Fact 2: Prime(3) ∧ 3 > 2. Modus Ponens yields Odd(3).
